verses.text: "Listen to this, you priests! Pay attention, people of Israel! Listen, royal family! This judgment is against you. You have been a trap at Mizpah, a net spread out on Mount Tabor.
The rebels are deep in slaughter, but I will punish all of them.
I know all about Ephraim. Israel is not hidden from me. Ephraim, you have now turned to prostitution. Israel is unclean.
Their actions do not allow them to return to their God. A spirit of unfaithfulness is in their hearts, and they do not know the LORD.
Israel's pride testifies against them. The people of Israel, even Ephraim, stumble in their sin, and Judah stumbles with them.
When they go with their flocks and herds to look for the LORD, they will not find him. He has turned away from them.
They have been unfaithful to the LORD. Their children are not his. Now their New Moon festivals will destroy them and their fields.
"Blow the horn in Gibeah and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound the battle cry in Beth Aven! Lead on, Benjamin!
Ephraim will be left in ruins on the day of punishment. Among the tribes of Israel I announce what is certain to happen.
Judah's leaders are like those who move boundary stones to steal land. I will pour out my anger on them like a flood of water.
Ephraim is crushed and trampled in judgment, because he was determined to follow worthless idols.
I am like a moth to Ephraim, like rot to the people of Judah.
"When Ephraim saw how sick he was, and Judah saw his sores, Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king for help. But he is not able to cure you or heal your sores.
I will be like a lion to Ephraim, like a strong young lion to Judah. I will tear them to pieces and go away. I will carry them off, and no one will rescue them.
Then I will go back to my place until they admit their guilt and look for me. In their misery they will search hard for me."
